maddeler.e: إِغْرِيقِيّ • (ʔiḡrīqiyy) (feminine إِغْرِيقِيَّة (ʔiḡrīqiyya), masculine plural إِغْرِيقِيُّون (ʔiḡrīqiyyūn), feminine plural إِغْرِيقِيَّات (ʔiḡrīqiyyāt))
maddeler.t: إِغْرِيق (ʔiḡrīq) + ـِيّ (-iyy). Probably from Latin Graecus of uncertain origin, perhaps derived from the toponym Γραῖα (Graîa) or from other Paleo-Balkanic forms from a tribal name Graii.
